title: Spice Labels
text: Spice Labels. This is my 2nd set of spice labels that I have ordered recently. These are better than the last, but they're still not perfect. What I like better about these is that the placement of the spice name is on the top of the label. That makes it easier to see them when they're in elevated rows. So that's really good! The thing that would make these even better is to have more types of spices. For example, in my kitchen, I have rubbed sage and sage leaves. There is only 1 sage label. Of course I could use a blank one, but then they wouldn't all be uniform. There are a few other spices like that where I have more than one type of the same but they're in different formats. Now some of the labels did differentiate between types, but not all of them did. And the ones that I do have in different formats are not weird ones. They're pretty common. The quality of these labels is good. The adhesion is adequate. I was able to quickly remove them to straighten them up as I was putting them on the jars. Overall, I am happy with these.

product_metadata.title: 160 Minimalist Spice Jar Labels for Spice Cabinet, Preprinted Herb Seasoning Kitchen Pantry Label Stickers, Waterproof Black Script Spice Jars Rack Label Sticker for Organization and Storage
